description: This file defines the Coocook::Controller::Email class, which manages email-related actions such as notifications, password resets, and verification within a web application. It uses Moose for object orientation and interacts with the web context to prepare email data and URLs.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Email
classes.description: Controller class handling email-related actions such as notifications, password recovery, and verification within the Coocook web application.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Initializes email signature and sets the current view to 'Email' before processing actions.

methods.name: notify_admin_about_registration
methods.description: Prepares email data to notify an admin about a new user registration, including anonymized email and user URLs.

methods.name: password_changed
methods.description: Prepares email data to notify a user about a password change, including a recovery URL.

methods.name: recovery_link
methods.description: Prepares email data with a recovery link for password reset, including token expiration.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Prepares email data for user email verification, including verification URL.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Sets the default 'from' address for emails if not already set.
